title: Trickplay
description: Serves "Seeking and resuming just work.". A preview of where the viewer is jumping to.
acceptanceCriteria: A viewer scrubbing in Octave sees a preview picture of where they will land, for any film, at most a stated number of seconds apart.
Previews are made when a title is first watched, or ahead by the operator's choice (JS-201's rule), within the storage budget, with storage per film-hour stated, on local disk and S3.
Making them never slows a playback or anything the operator waits for.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
notes: Requested by Fluster, the client that ships with jellyscale: #105. Access: trickplay needs a token. (access model, 2026-11-16) Roku, Streamyfin, Fladder and Jellyfin for Android ask for tiles (read from source, 2026-11-20); what an app shows on today's 404 is recorded by JS-075 (BL-222).
